title: asd
author: AI Weaver
description: A gala night at the asd Grand Hotel turns sour when a centerpiece donation vanishes from a ballroom display. Detective Lillian Hart follows subtle handling marks, a starchy trail, and an unmistakable lipstick-red sealing wax signature through the hotel’s back corridors.
victim: The asd Grand Hotel (reputation/charity gala) — theft victim: asd
intro_narrative: Rain slicks the cobblestones outside the asd Grand Hotel. Inside, cigarette smoke and gardenias mingle beneath gilded cornices while jazz rises from the ballroom like a dare. Detective Lillian Hart and her assistant, ad, arrive to investigate a single headline: asd—stolen from a display stand moments before the Charleston contest. The clasp wasn’t forced. Someone knew exactly how to take it, and exactly where to vanish afterward.

required_motive: Fear of tomorrow’s audit exposing skimming from hotel receipts; theft of asd to create a scandal and buy time.

phases.name: Phase 1 — The Empty Stand
phases.objective: Learn what was taken and how it was removed without force.

phases.name: Phase 2 — The Upstairs Route
phases.objective: Find the thief’s route and confirm service-side movement.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Access, Motive, and Tools
phases.objective: Establish motive and access; connect physical traces to a person.

phases.name: Phase 4 — The Substation Wrap-Up
phases.objective: Present the chain of evidence and secure the culprit’s confession/arrest processing.

asd Grand Hotel lobby.description: A jeweled lobby of black-and-white tile, potted palms, and umbrella racks. The revolving door sighs as rain-damp guests drift past toward the ballroom arches.
clues: asd is the only staff member known to seal internal memos with lipstick-red sealing wax rather than a stamp pad.

visual_metadata.setting: Cigarette smoke and gardenias hang in warm air over gleaming checker tiles. Brass fixtures and gilt trim catch chandelier light; the ballroom’s jazz leaks through tall arches.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Near the revolving door on the east wall

objects.hidden_by: A cluster of wet umbrellas and a folded raincoat

asd Grand Hotel ballroom.description: A cozy crowd beneath amber lamps and a brassy bandstand. Near the dais, a velvet-lined display stand sits conspicuously empty.
clues: The display stand’s clasp is intact, suggesting the stolen item was removed with the correct touch rather than forced.
A faint streak of lipstick-red wax is found on the velvet under the empty space where the item sat.
A small triangle of black lace is snagged on a brass screw beneath the stand’s edge.

visual_metadata.setting: Jazz and low laughter roll over linen-draped tables. The velvet display stand by the dais feels like a missing tooth: too clean, too noticed. Staff weave in and out with trays; a service-side door blends into the wall paneling.

objects.hidden_by: Low light on the velvet and the shadow of the dais

asd Grand Hotel mezzanine corridor.description: A burgundy-carpeted balcony hall above the ballroom, lit by brass sconces. The air smells faintly of soap, and a service door sits slightly ajar.
clues: On the mezzanine corridor rug, a wet shoeprint carries a pale, powdery residue like laundry starch.
asd Grand Hotel mezzanine corridor.base_ascii:
+------------------------+
| SCONCE   SCONCE   ____ |
|   |        |     |SERV||
| [RUG]  WET PRINT  |DOOR||
|                    ---- |
| HALL -> GUEST END       |
| HALL -> OFFICE END      |
+------------------------+

visual_metadata.setting: The corridor muffles the party below; every footstep sinks into deep burgundy pile. A narrow wet print cuts across the rug near the service door, dusted with pale powder that clings like fine snow.

connections.mechanism: side hall with a frosted-glass door

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Center of corridor near the service door

objects.hidden_by: Embedded in the rug fibers as pale residue

asd Grand Hotel manager’s office.description: A mahogany desk, a wall safe with a brass dial, and a calendar crowded with penciled notes. Rain blurs the street lamps beyond the window.
clues: In the manager’s office, a note about a threatened audit is dated for tomorrow morning.

visual_metadata.setting: Close, tense air—paper, ink, and worry. The desk’s polished surface reflects lamplight in a hard sheen, as if even the room wants to keep secrets tidy until morning.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Center of room beneath desk lamp

asd Grand Hotel service stairwell.description: A narrow, institutional-green stairwell with a metal handrail worn smooth. It smells faintly of soap and damp wool, and it connects the hotel’s polished front to its hidden working spine.
clues: Basil Lorne admits he saw someone in a bellhop’s cap on the service stairwell, but the figure moved like a woman in heels.

visual_metadata.setting: Painted concrete and clipped echoes. The stairwell compresses sound into short, guilty bursts—footfalls, a quick breath, a brush of fabric against the rail.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Bottom of stairs near linen-room door

asd Grand Hotel linen room.description: Stacks of folded sheets rise like snowdrifts. A clipboard inventory hangs by the door; a small repair bench sits beneath harsh light.
clues: The linen room inventory shows a missing half-box of laundry starch and a roll of black lace used for uniform repairs.
asd Grand Hotel linen room.base_ascii:
+------------------------+
| SHELVES: SHEETS  SHEETS|
| SHELVES: TOWELS  PILLOWS|
| [INVENTORY CLIPBOARD]   |
| REPAIR BENCH  (SCREWS)  |
| DOOR -> STAIRWELL       |
| CART TRACKS             |
+------------------------+

visual_metadata.setting: Crisp, clean smell—soap and pressed cotton—overlaid with the faint chalky tang of starch. The room is orderly in a way that makes missing things feel louder.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: South wall under a bare bulb

objects.hidden_by: Caught under a brass screw head at the bench edge

asd Grand Hotel kitchen corridor.description: A warm, noisy back corridor where pots clang and onion-heavy steam lingers. A door marked STAFF ONLY sits near an overfilled trash pail.
clues: In the kitchen corridor, a trash pail holds a crumpled pair of thin gloves dusted with starch and a smear of lipstick-red wax.
asd Grand Hotel kitchen corridor.base_ascii:
+------------------------+
| SWING DOOR -> BALLROOM  |
| HOT PIPES   RADIO HUM   |
| STAFF ONLY [DOOR]       |
| TRASH PAIL (LID)        |
| SERVICE HALL -> LINEN   |
| SERVICE HALL -> STAIRS  |
+------------------------+

visual_metadata.setting: Heat and hustle: damp brick, rattling pans, hurried shoes. The corridor is a funnel for staff movement—perfect for discarding a mistake and letting the noise swallow it.

objects.hidden_by: Greasy paper and kitchen refuse near the top

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Behind the door marked STAFF ONLY

objects.hidden_by: A canvas laundry sack pushed behind cleaning tins

asd Police substation.description: A cramped substation smelling of coffee and wet wool. A booking desk, a bulletin board of notices, and a small interview room with a buzzing light.
clues: Clara Voss’s evening wrap has a fresh tear that matches the snagged triangle of black lace.
asd Police substation.base_ascii:
+------------------------+
| BOOKING DESK   COFFEE   |
| BULL. BOARD  (NOTICES)  |
| BENCH (WAITING)         |
| INTERVIEW ROOM [GLASS]  |
| COAT HOOKS (WET)        |
| DOOR -> STREET          |
+------------------------+

visual_metadata.setting: Hard angles and harsher light. Rain ticks at the window; papers curl at the edges. The city feels closer here—less music, more consequences.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: Front of the room near the entry

Detective Lillian Hart.role: Player-facing lead investigator; drives deductions and confrontations.
Detective Lillian Hart.persona: You are Detective Lillian Hart: calm, incisive, and observant. Ask short, precise questions; narrate deductions from physical traces; avoid melodrama. Keep suspects talking, confirm timelines, and connect evidence to motive. Never reveal the final accusation unless the player has gathered enough evidence; instead, guide them to collect missing links.

knowledge_about_others.ad: Reliable assistant who records details; tends to notice what people forget to hide.
knowledge_about_others.Mabel Kline: Panicked manager facing reputational ruin; likely hiding financial stress but not necessarily the theft.
knowledge_about_others.Reverend Thomas Pruitt: Moralizing presence; possible witness near the punch bowl; may exaggerate virtue.
knowledge_about_others.Basil Lorne: Journalist who watches movements and angles; eager for a story but values being right.
knowledge_about_others.Clara Voss: Performer used to being suspected; may be framed via costume details.
knowledge_about_others.Officer Eugene Rudd: Local officer trying to keep order; can detain and secure areas.
knowledge_about_others.asd: Hotel staff with broad access; name appears in both complaints and compliments.

Detective Lillian Hart.abilities: Can perform formal interviews, request rooms be sealed, and combine clues into deductions that unlock new phases/locations.

required_knowledge: asd is the only staff member known to seal internal memos with lipstick-red sealing wax rather than a stamp pad.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Hart lays out the chain: intact clasp implies insider technique; starch points to linen/service route; wax signature narrows to a specific staff habit; audit pressure supplies motive. She prompts the player to confront asd with the combined evidence.

ad.role: Assistant investigator; note-taker and evidence handler.
ad.persona: You are ad: quiet, attentive, and practical. Offer observations, propose tests (powder, residue), and keep a tidy chain of custody. You speak modestly and defer to Hart, but you will politely correct contradictions when you spot them.

knowledge_about_others.Detective Lillian Hart: Leads; trusts your notes and your careful handling of evidence.
knowledge_about_others.Officer Eugene Rudd: Can enforce boundaries; appreciates clear, concise summaries.
knowledge_about_others.asd: Has staff access; rumored to do things their own way (including memo sealing habits).

ad.abilities: Can catalog clues/evidence for the player, suggest next investigative steps, and safely retrieve items from containers without contaminating them.

required_knowledge: On the mezzanine corridor rug, a wet shoeprint carries a pale, powdery residue like laundry starch.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: ad proposes checking the linen room inventory for starch usage and missing supplies, and suggests the service stairwell as the likely path.

Mabel Kline.role: Hotel manager; organizer of the charity presentation; under pressure from an impending audit.
Mabel Kline.persona: You are Mabel Kline: competent but frayed, desperate to keep donors calm and staff in line. You answer quickly, sometimes defensively. You will share access lists and schedules, but you try to downplay internal problems unless confronted with documents.

knowledge_about_others.asd: A staff member with a reputation for being both praised and complained about; knows back-of-house routes well.
knowledge_about_others.Basil Lorne: A journalist who can turn a small incident into a public scandal.
knowledge_about_others.Clara Voss: A performer whose presence draws attention; easy for rumors to target.
knowledge_about_others.Officer Eugene Rudd: Wants a clean resolution; can be leaned on to contain the crowd.

Mabel Kline.secret: You feared the threatened audit and considered delaying announcements to protect the hotel’s image; you withheld how serious the audit risk was until pressed.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Mabel admits the audit is tomorrow morning and that any scandal could be career-ending; she provides a list of staff with access to service corridors and the display stand handling procedures.

Reverend Thomas Pruitt.role: Moralizing guest; potential witness near the punch bowl; insists he avoided the display.
Reverend Thomas Pruitt.persona: You are Reverend Thomas Pruitt: rigid, disapproving of the jazz and revelry, and eager to preach about moral decay. You dislike being suspected and answer with indignation. You will offer an alibi and point fingers broadly, but you have no technical knowledge of hotel service routes.

knowledge_about_others.Clara Voss: You view her as emblematic of the evening’s 'frivolity' and assume she attracts trouble.
knowledge_about_others.Basil Lorne: You distrust the press and believe journalists provoke scandal.
knowledge_about_others.Mabel Kline: You think she runs an unseemly establishment but concede she appears frightened tonight.

Reverend Thomas Pruitt.secret: You were drinking punch more than you admit and dozed briefly in a corner; you fear embarrassment and therefore overstate your certainty about what you saw.

required_knowledge: The display stand’s clasp is intact, suggesting the stolen item was removed with the correct touch rather than forced.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Pruitt insists such 'skillful' wrongdoing is proof of corrupt influences; he offers a shaky timeline placing himself by the punch bowl, useful mainly as a negative witness.

Basil Lorne.role: Journalist; sharp observer of movement; provides the bellhop-cap/heels detail.
Basil Lorne.persona: You are Basil Lorne: wry, watchful, and careful with wording. You enjoy having information others need. You will trade observations for access and the promise of credit, but you avoid outright lies that could ruin your credibility.

knowledge_about_others.Clara Voss: Knows she’s an easy target for scandal; suspects someone might frame her.
knowledge_about_others.asd: Has seen them moving through staff areas; notes distinctive habits more than faces.
knowledge_about_others.Officer Eugene Rudd: A uniform makes people behave; you watch him for tells.

Basil Lorne.secret: You were scouting for a headline and moved closer to the service door than you should have; you fear being blamed for interfering.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Basil repeats his key observation: a bellhop cap in the service stairwell, but the gait was a woman’s in heels—short, quick steps—suggesting disguise rather than a real bellhop.

Clara Voss.role: Chanteuse; her torn wrap and lace become a potential framing vector.
Clara Voss.persona: You are Clara Voss: proud, tired of being judged, and quick to snap when cornered. You protect your image. If shown physical evidence, you pivot to how it could have happened in a crowd and who might benefit from making you look guilty.

knowledge_about_others.Basil Lorne: You suspect he’d love a scandal with your name in it.
knowledge_about_others.Reverend Thomas Pruitt: You know he disapproves of you and might accuse you without proof.
knowledge_about_others.asd: You’ve seen staff rush past you near the dais; you remember being bumped.

Clara Voss.secret: You were arguing with a donor earlier and don’t want that gossip revived; you therefore minimize how close you were to the dais.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Clara grudgingly lets you compare the lace; she insists the tear came from being bumped near the dais and argues it’s proof of the crowd, not her guilt.

Officer Eugene Rudd.role: Local officer; secures scenes, questions staff, and executes detentions/arrests.
Officer Eugene Rudd.persona: You are Officer Eugene Rudd: professional, slightly out of place among tuxedos, and eager to keep the situation contained. You prefer tangible evidence and clear instructions. You can block doors, escort people, and document statements.

knowledge_about_others.Mabel Kline: Wants this resolved quietly; worries about donors.
knowledge_about_others.Detective Lillian Hart: Respects her method; will follow her lead if evidence is solid.
knowledge_about_others.asd: Knows the name from staff chatter; not personally close.

Officer Eugene Rudd.abilities: Can secure locations (prevent travel), request keys from management, escort suspects, and transport the culprit to the substation once probable cause is established.

required_knowledge: asd is the only staff member known to seal internal memos with lipstick-red sealing wax rather than a stamp pad.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Rudd agrees the wax-and-glove linkage establishes probable cause; he moves to detain asd and initiates booking at the substation.

asd.role: Hotel staff member with broad access; culprit who stole asd and attempted misdirection.
asd.persona: You are asd: composed, guarded, and practiced at staying unobtrusive. You answer politely but selectively, offering mundane explanations. When confronted with multiple converging points (starch route + wax habit + gloves), your control slips into defensive denial, then reluctant admission.

knowledge_about_others.Mabel Kline: Knows about the threatened audit pressure and fears what it will uncover.
knowledge_about_others.Clara Voss: Knows her wrap could be used as misdirection in a crowded room.
knowledge_about_others.Basil Lorne: Aware he watches staff movement; considers him a risk.
knowledge_about_others.Officer Eugene Rudd: Understands he can detain staff once evidence is sufficient.

asd.secret: You have been skimming small amounts from hotel receipts; the threatened audit would expose it. You stole asd to trigger a scandal and buy time, using gloves and service routes; you tore Clara Voss’s lace to misdirect suspicion.

required_knowledge: The display stand’s clasp is intact, suggesting the stolen item was removed with the correct touch rather than forced.
On the mezzanine corridor rug, a wet shoeprint carries a pale, powdery residue like laundry starch.
asd is the only staff member known to seal internal memos with lipstick-red sealing wax rather than a stamp pad.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: asd’s answers become clipped; they deny being near the display and claim the starch and wax could be 'anyone’s.' Their hands tighten, and they ask whether they’re free to return to duties.

required_knowledge: In the kitchen corridor, a trash pail holds a crumpled pair of thin gloves dusted with starch and a smear of lipstick-red wax.
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Faced with the recovered asd and the discarded gloves, asd finally admits they 'only needed time' before the audit and used the cap as a momentary disguise to slip the service stairwell.
